column1: # GE-T10's gold (SMYSL-2.5 §5.5; TX-P8 step 4): for each question in questions.tsv, each slot
# its intent fills under `smysl/dossier/1`, and the units of corpus.smy a reader asking that
# question would want there, by label.
# WHO WROTE THIS. The hand that wrote the templates, after writing them — see corpus.smy. GE-T10
# asks for expert-filled slots and this is not that: no second person has read it, and none is
# available to (the project has no independent coders). It is written to the criteria below
# and not to the templates, and was not changed after a run except to correct a label that
# did not match the corpus's own comment on the unit; every such correction is the comment
# CRITERIA, per slot. A unit belongs to a slot by what it says, not by its kind or its edges:
#   definition     says what the subject is
#   characteristic states a current property of the subject — not a superseded account, not a
#                  rebuttal (that is counter), not a passing mention of the name
#   exemplifies    is a case or instance of a claim about the subject
#   counter        disputes a current claim about the subject; for explain and verify, only a
#                  claim bearing on what the question asked of the subject
#   open-question  is a question about the subject
#   cause          brings about something about the subject, bearing on what was asked
#   evidence       an observation or datum bearing on what the question asked
#   hypothesis     a conjecture about the subject bearing on the why that was asked
#   support        a ground of the claim the question asks to verify
#   reported       reported speech of the proposition the question asks about
#   holder         names who holds a position on the subject
#   stance         a position on the subject asserted by a named holder
#   introduction   records the subject's first appearance or origin
#   revision       an account of the subject that a later one replaced
#   location       mentions the subject, in any language — every one of them
#   related        elaborates a unit about the subject
#   dependent      rests on a unit about the subject, at any depth
#   contrast       is set against a unit about the subject
# Columns, tab-separated: qid, slot, the labels separated by spaces (`-` for an empty slot,
# which the gold then expects to be a `gap`).
